content: Take this medication by mouth as directed by your doctor, typically once daily at bedtime. After taking this medication, avoid consuming alcohol until the next day. Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while using this medication unless your doctor or pharmacist confirms it is safe, as grapefruit can increase the likelihood of side effects. Use this medication regularly to achieve the best results. Common side effects may include drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, or fatigue. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks. These risks increase if the medication is taken with alcohol, less than two hours after alcohol consumption, at a time other than bedtime, or in doses higher than prescribed. If you feel dizzy or lightheaded, lie down immediately. A severe allergic reaction to this medication is rare. If you experience symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, seek emergency medical attention by calling 911. For non-emergency overdoses, contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Before starting this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause dizziness or drowsiness, which can be worsened by alcohol or marijuana (cannabis). Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness for at least six hours after taking this medication or until you can do so safely. Avoid alcoholic beverages. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is unknown if this medication passes into breast milk. Due to potential risks to the infant, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions may alter how this medication works or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Certain medications, such as azole antifungals (e.g., fluconazole, ketoconazole), calcium channel blockers (e.g., diltiazem, verapamil), macrolide antibiotics (e.g., clarithromycin, erythromycin), nefazodone, rifamycins (e.g., rifabutin, rifampin), and ritonavir, may affect the removal of this medication from your body, potentially altering its effectiveness. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For further guidance, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
